title: EthicsMH: A Pilot Benchmark for Ethical Reasoning in Mental Health AI
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not explicitly measure aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates ethical reasoning in mental health AI, with scenarios that include 'cultural perspectives' and 'cultural lenses', which could implicitly involve religion, but it is not a specified component of the evaluation.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
